deprecated_yaml_import_issue_credentials.description:
Configuring the {integration_title} integration through YAML is deprecated. Your configuration uses SNMPv3 credentials, which cannot be imported automatically.

Set up the integration through the UI with your SNMPv3 credentials, then remove configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.

entity_id_changed.description:
The SNMP device tracker for `{mac}` could not keep its entity id `{entity_id}` because it is already in use, so it is now `{new_entity_id}`.

Update the automations and scripts that refer to `{entity_id}`.
